DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF)

The combination of a chronic, progressive dry cough, the presence of interstitial markings on your chest X-ray, and the restrictive pattern shown in your pulmonary function tests (reduced FVC and FEV1 with a reduced ratio) strongly points to interstitial lung disease. Given the chronic nature of your symptoms and the absence of other specific risk factors like asbestos exposure or connective tissue disease, the most likely diagnosis is Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis.
